query:
UPDATE email_sign_in_codes
                SET failures = CASE WHEN failures_since > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
                                    THEN failures + 1 ELSE 1 END,
                    failures_since = CASE WHEN failures_since > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
                                          THEN failures_since ELSE NOW() END
              WHERE user_id = $1
          RETURNING failures
